title: Impassible Saw
text:
Walkthrough

There is another buzzsaw puzzle nearby. You have to activate the left button, wait 1 second, and walk to the right button to activate it. The left box should drop, and then you will need to pull it under the right box. This will create a stack that you can use to climb up.

This requires precise timing, and you may have to adjust the delay if you're too early or late.
